slots.name: Catacombs RNG Meters
lore: Your Catacombs RNG Meters fill with
Dungeon Score each time you
complete an S or S+ run.
Your selected RNG drop will be
guaranteed to appear in a chest
once your RNG Meter for a floor is
full!

slots.name: Catacombs (F1) RNG Meter
lore: Your RNG Meter fills each time you
complete an S+ run on Catacombs
(F1) by your score for that run.
Completing S runs fills your meter
with 70% of your score.
When your meter is full, your
selected drop will be guaranteed to
drop in a chest in your next eligible
run!
You don't have an RNG drop
selected. Choose one to start
progressing towards it!
Stored Dungeon Score: 732
Click to view!
